calendarFeeds.title: Calendar feeds
calendarFeeds.lede: The roadmap in your own calendar, updated as dates move.
calendarFeeds.addressTitle: Copy this address into your calendar
calendarFeeds.addressBody: It is shown once and never again. Anyone who has it can see which regulatory changes your bank has open work on, so revoke it here if it leaks.
calendarFeeds.limitReached: You already have as many feeds as one person can hold. Revoke one you no longer use first.
calendarFeeds.revokeBody: The address stops working at once, and your calendar stops updating at its next fetch. You can create a new feed at any time.
calendarFeeds.emptyBody: Create one to see the roadmap in your calendar.
